title: Clonable on WordPress (hands-on test)
source: Our own measurement log of 1 October 2026 (times in UTC, taken from the screenshot timestamps). Written up as structured data on 7 October 2026; the test itself is unchanged. The private preview link and its access code are left out.

affiliate_relationship.Clonable: affiliate programme on Reditus, we may be paid; this page is also our entry in Clonable's review content campaign on Reditus (one-off EUR 30 if approved). Clonable did not see the page before it went live.

method.site: fresh WordPress 7.1.2 on PHP 8.5, Twenty Twenty-Three theme, temporary TasteWP sandbox, no other translation plugin
method.own_content: one page 'WordPress maintenance plans' (intro, heading, three-item list, prices 49 and 89 euro, closing line) plus WordPress's sample post and page
method.plan: Clonable free plan, new account, no card
method.plugin: Clonable 2.13.3 from the WordPress plugin directory

steps.observed: Site scan completed in about 10 s: WordPress, English (United States), plugins sorted into Not supported 0 / Has overlap 0 / Supported 1 / Unknown 0; warning that Cloudflare may make detection less accurate.
German chosen; a formality setting appeared; context step offers an AI Context Assistant ('Takes 5-10 minutes') or a free text field; we wrote two sentences.
Preview ready about 2 min 13 s after the build started, about 4 min 45 s after typing the address.
Test page fully in German, menu included, formal 'Sie'; URL slug stayed English; the sample 'Hello world' post came out informal, mirroring its casual original.
Price changed from 49 to 59 euro on the English page; the German clone showed '59 Euro' on the first reload.
Pages = 3 before and after (Privacy Policy draft, Sample Page, our page); no German copies in WordPress; the only addition to the install was the Clonable plugin.
'Hallo Welt!' changed to 'Hallo, Welt!' in the clone editor; 'Translation saved successfully'; the public preview showed the change.
API key pasted (by Daniel, not by Claude); 'successfully connected'; hreflang x-default/en-us/de-de present in the head of original and clone.
Floating switcher shows both languages; clicking German did not navigate in our automated session (iframe and postMessage).
Translation Replacements and Glossary show 'Plan upgrade required' on the free plan.

plans_seen.in_app_1_oct: Free: Translated pages 0/25, Proofreading 0/500, Sites 1/1, Clones 1/1. Starter 1 clone 50 pages EUR 25/mo, Business 400 pages EUR 49, Pro 1,200 EUR 79, Expert 5,000 EUR 249, Premium 50,000 EUR 999.
plans_seen.public_pricing_page_1_oct: Free EUR 0, 1 clone, 20 pages; Business EUR 49, 3 clones, 400 pages; Pro EUR 79, 5 clones, 1,200 pages (Recommended); Expert EUR 249, 10 clones, 5,000 pages; Premium EUR 999, 20 clones, 50,000 pages.
plans_seen.difference: The free plan's page limit is 25 in the app and 20 on the public pricing page; the app marks Business as recommended, the public page marks Pro.

not_covered: DNS go-live on a production domain
